local f = workspace.Phase1Map.town1_extra
local n = 0
for _, m in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
  if m:IsA('Model') and m.Name == 'T01_demon_skull_hq' then
    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
      if p:IsA('MeshPart') then
        p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 203, 178)
        p.Material = Enum.Material.Limestone
        p.Anchored = true
        n += 1
      end
    end
  end
end
return 'painted ' .. n
